entry: Nonproduction telemetry foundation eligible; EXT0022 blocks production, not build. No operational owners assigned. IMB0100 first; IMB0101 only against stable existing controls and approved responsibilities.

operating_spec.content:
# BONIRA — Approved Operating Specification

Governed by `PD-005`.

| Responsibility | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Release Owner | Designated accountable responsibility per production release; exact assignee not invented |
| Incident Owner | Designated accountable responsibility per incident |
| Production Activation Authority | Explicitly designated; technical superuser status alone is insufficient |
| Escalation Responsibility | Explicit path required; no timer/severity/SLA invented |
| Emergency / Support Access Authority | Explicit, scoped, auditable and revocable |
| Rollback / Roll-forward Responsibility | Recorded in release/incident evidence |
| Access Revocation Responsibility | Explicit owner for expiry/revoke |

Release evidence includes version/change/migration/activation/rollback-or-roll-forward evidence.
Incident evidence includes identity/timestamps/owner/log evidence/actions/access grants/resolution evidence.

`ON-CALL POLICY ≠ AUTOMATIC 24×7 STAFFED ROTATION`

No SLA, SLO, response time, severity scheme or staffed rotation is invented.

`PRODUCTION-OPERATIONS-READINESS: NOT YET PROVEN`
`HUMAN SIGN-OFF: NOT EXECUTED`
`IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZATION: NOT YET GRANTED`

frozen_pd.decision:
— Explicit Operating Ownership

**Domain:** Production / Operations  
**Accepted option / disposition:** Option B — Explicit Operating Ownership  
**V1 position:** PRODUCTION ESSENTIAL  
**Status:** `FROZEN`

**Decision statement:** Release Owner, Incident Owner, escalation, emergency/support access, production activation responsibility and incident evidence require explicit operating policy; on-call does not imply 24×7 staffing.

**Production / evidence boundary:** `Approved Operating Specification` is required before Production Operations Readiness. It may define only explicitly approved operating-policy details. Runtime drills and human operational readiness remain separate.

**Source provenance:** `PD-005`  
**Affected Integration / governing links:** —  
**Affected PDM:** —  
**Affected Journeys:** —

**Guardrail / fail-closed rule:** UNSPECIFIED OPERATING POLICY — DO NOT INVENT

implementation: Server-generated request correlation id and structured request outcome/duration logs only, with fixed allowlisted fields; no request body/query/headers/path/actor/tenant identifiers or exception text. Standard-library logging only; no external sink or new endpoint. Preserve response/business behavior when telemetry delivery fails; sanitized stderr failure signal, no readiness claim.
boundary: No financial/domain workflow instrumentation or semantics invented. Existing support access request-confirm-independent approve-use-revoke/audit services referenced, not replaced. Named responsibilities/alert destination/operational signals and acceptance evidence remain missing; no alert threshold/SLA/rotation/emergency bypass/approval UI invented.
